A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 18-page versions of the same study. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the main text, equations, figures, tables, and all appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original decoding-order, entropy, and JustGRPO experiments, including benchmark results and appendix sensitivity and training-efficiency analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and reorganized appendices.

M1.justification: Both versions use autoregressive rollouts, exact autoregressive likelihoods, and standard GRPO with the same masked-input construction. The top-25%-entropy Ours-Fast variant already appears in v1 Appendix B.5 and is retained in v3 Appendix D.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation retain GSM8K, MATH/MATH-500, HumanEval, MBPP, and the selected AceCoder-87K training data. Replacing some references to MATH with MATH-500 clarifies the benchmark already identified in v1 Table 1.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains d1, wd1, d-TreeRPO, ESPO, GDPO, and SPG, with the same contextual LLaDA-1.5 and LLaDOU rows. Added citations and capitalization corrections do not introduce comparators. Appendix sampler and efficiency comparisons also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Sections 3 and 5 and Table 2 retain the splits, decoding settings, temperatures, generation lengths, metrics, and training configuration. Explicitly identifying generation length in figure captions documents existing experiments without establishing a protocol change.

E4.justification: Temperature, sampling-algorithm, block-size, extended connector-entropy, and training-efficiency analyses are retained. v1 Appendices B.4 and B.5 become v3 Appendices C and D; these are reorganized analyses, with the same experimental questions and evidence.

E5.justification: The Pass@k estimator and correlation reporting are retained. Neither version reports additional experimental seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Figure 3 corrects benchmark attribution by exchanging the existing GSM8K/MATH-500 and HumanEval/MBPP panels beneath their headings. This changes which task the displayed values describe, while retaining the underlying curves. Table 1 scores, appendix results, and the overall AR-order advantage remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 2.1 corrects the missing minus sign in the negative-ELBO loss, now Equation 2. Section 4.2 also repairs the probability-distribution notation. The remaining mathematical changes largely standardize indexing and notation; no new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: Comparative superiority is modestly qualified: the introduction changes 'best achieved' to 'can be better achieved', and Table 1 drops the explicit claim of state-of-the-art performance across every task and sequence length. The central flexibility-trap, JustGRPO, and preserved-parallel-decoding contributions remain.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 and Figure 4 replace inclusion of reasoning traces with inclusion of solvable problems, matching the measured coverage. Section 3.2 makes the mechanism explanation less categorical, while Section 4.2 replaces claimed autoregressive-model reasoning depth with benefits from AR-order exploration.

D1.justification: Figures 1 and 7 explicitly identify generation length as 256. Appendix A.2 removes the statement that GSM8K training takes approximately three days. Hardware, hyperparameters, data preparation, reward details, the project-page link, and Figure 12 timing evidence remain.

R1.justification: Section 6 adds Hong et al., Shen et al., and Du et al., distinguishing prior Pass@k studies and a pretraining critique of arbitrary order from this work's reasoning/RL focus. Tang et al. and Pan et al. supply citations for the already compared wd1 and d-TreeRPO methods.

P1.justification: v3 locally rewrites the introduction, mechanism explanation, method remarks, and related work, while standardizing terminology and mathematical indexing. Appendix B.4/B.5 become separate Appendices C/D; the main narrative and seven-section structure remain.

P2.justification: v3 corrects Figure 3 panel alignment, adjusts Figure 7 annotations, and refreshes Figures 9–10. Figure 10 changes fractional tick labels to percentages consistent with its axis label and revises colors. Table 1 accommodates row citations; the existing figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: Corrected benchmark alignment in Figure 3, the repaired loss sign, more precise coverage and performance statements, and clearer baseline attribution improve accuracy and interpretability. Removing the three-day training estimate slightly reduces cost documentation, but hardware details and Figure 12 timing curves remain. The net improvement is limited but clear.
